SELECT 'POST' AS resourceType, p.post_id AS resourceId, p.member_id AS authorMemberId, m.login_id AS authorLoginId, m.nickname AS authorNickname, p.content, p.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(cm.moderation_status, 'VISIBLE') AS moderationStatus, cm.reason AS moderationReason, cm.moderated_by_member_id AS moderatedByMemberId, cm.updated_at AS moderatedAt FROM community_posts p INNER JOIN members m ON m.member_id = p.member_id LEFT JOIN community_content_moderations cm ON cm.resource_type = 'POST' AND cm.resource_id = p.post_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'COMMENT' AS resourceType, c.comment_id AS resourceId, c.member_id AS authorMemberId, m.login_id AS authorLoginId, m.nickname AS authorNickname, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(cm.moderation_status, 'VISIBLE') AS moderationStatus, cm.reason AS moderationReason, cm.moderated_by_member_id AS moderatedByMemberId, cm.updated_at AS moderatedAt FROM community_comments c INNER JOIN members m ON m.member_id = c.member_id LEFT JOIN community_content_moderations cm ON cm.resource_type = 'COMMENT' AND cm.resource_id = c.comment_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_content_moderations ( resource_type, resource_id, moderation_status, reason, moderated_by_member_id ) VALUES ( #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{moderationStatus}, #{reason}, #{moderatedByMemberId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE moderation_status = VALUES(moderation_status), reason = VALUES(reason), moderated_by_member_id = VALUES(moderated_by_member_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.resource_type AS resourceType, r.resource_id AS resourceId, r.report_reason AS reportReason, r.report_status AS reportStatus, r.reporter_member_id AS reporterMemberId, m.login_id AS reporterLoginId, m.nickname AS reporterNickname,
COALESCE(p.member_id, c.member_id) AS targetMemberId, target.login_id AS targetLoginId, target.nickname AS targetNickname,
r.handled_by_member_id AS handledByMemberId, handler.login_id AS handledByLoginId, handler.nickname AS handledByNickname, r.handled_at AS handledAt,
r.created_at AS createdAt
FROM community_reports r INNER JOIN members m ON m.member_id = r.reporter_member_id LEFT JOIN community_posts p ON r.resource_type = 'POST' AND r.resource_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN community_comments c ON r.resource_type = 'COMMENT' AND r.resource_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN members target ON target.member_id = COALESCE(p.member_id, c.member_id) LEFT JOIN members handler ON handler.member_id = r.handled_by_member_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
